about.title: No noise. Just the work.
about.body:
We opened with one idea — a serious floor without the fluff. No queue for the rack, no chrome for its own sake. Calibrated iron, coaches who compete, and members who keep showing up.

A decade later that hasn't changed.

No joining fee. You pay for the plan you choose — monthly, quarterly, half-year or annual.
Bank or wallet transfer. You upload the receipt in your member portal and it's approved within a day.
Yes — every plan includes freeze days. Request it from the portal and your end date moves out.

intro.title: Built for people who train
intro.body:
Iron Gym opened in 2014 with one idea: a serious training floor without the noise. No mirrors-only chrome, no queue for the rack — calibrated iron, competent coaching, and members who show up.

A decade later, one flagship floor in downtown Cairo, an eighteen-strong coaching team, and a membership built around the people who keep coming back.

items.title: The first rack
items.body: A single room, four platforms, and a handful of lifters who wanted somewhere serious.

items.title: The floor doubles
items.body: We knocked through the wall next door. 900 sqm, dedicated conditioning zone.

items.title: Coaching team formed
items.body: Full-time coaches, structured programming, monthly reviews for every member.

items.title: Digital membership
items.body: QR access, portal payments and freeze requests — the floor stayed the same.

items.title: The work is the point
items.body: No gimmicks, no theatre. Load the bar, do the reps, review the numbers.

items.title: Coaching is a craft
items.body: Our coaches compete and teach. Programming is written, not templated.

items.title: Everyone gets a rack
items.body: We cap membership to floor capacity. You never queue for a lift.

items.title: Respect the iron
items.body: Maintained weekly, calibrated, and put back. The gym you'd want to train in.
